scope: Full reading of all ten EN/DE manuscripts, including ancient Chinese quotations, complete supplied translations, main arguments, captions, optional readings, edition/image/rights notes and references. This is model-assisted editorial proofreading, not a claim of native-speaker human certification or fresh authentication of the museum images.

changes.details: Made the plural reference to occurrences of 一 explicit; replaced two literal expressions about ending observation and anticipating the next encounter with natural English while retaining the argument about leaving later viewers room.
Corrected zusammengesetzt spelling; clarified that evidence remains available for others to examine and that a useful question does not prescribe the next viewer's perception.
Changed wording implying that 七 has missing strokes to wording saying it has fewer strokes, preserving the distinction between a sparse intact character and damage.

preservation: No text units, ancient quotations, translations, arguments, examples, image captions, links, rights statements or optional readings removed. Original received manuscripts untouched.
observations_for_parent: Follow-up completed at the parent's request: EP07 EN/DE rights notes now describe the illustrations as originally supplied with a local review package and now used for commentary. Historical-artwork and modern-photo rights remain distinct; no additional written museum republication permission was obtained; access and attribution do not authorise republication, commercial use or sublicensing.
EP11 preserves cautious readings of 季祖母 and 七首, and distinguishes the 185 stele from the Ming post-excavation rubbing and later album mounting.
